同じsession IDが別serverにもあり得る前提でnamespace化する。parent sessionのgrantは子sessionへ無条件継承せず、委譲範囲との積を取る。

state.design_pin:
採用済みbundleをLabから取得し、schema・digest・scope・host/model互換性を検証する。session開始時にpolicyをpinし、通常の更新は新しいsessionへ適用する。既存sessionの評価中にcandidateへすり替えない。

```text
Lab active pointer: v12 → v13
既存session A: v12のまま
新規session B: v13
緊急失効: Aのadvisoryを停止し、理由を明示
```

roll backは次のpolicy適用を戻すことであり、過去のコード変更や外部操作を戻すことではない。問題版が関わった成果物には再確認を付ける。

server再起動は新しいsession開始とは限らない。既存sessionをresumeする時は、Labに保存した元のpolicy pinを復元する。新server epochへの対応を検証してから再bindし、復元できない場合はactive最新版へ自動置換せず保留する。旧epochの処理中結果は破棄するが、pinの履歴自体は失わない。

state.design_guidance:
context hookはsystem/messages/options/toolsを変更でき、固定READMEはdispatch直前の変更として説明する。[OC06](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/a2594ddefb6557ecf7e7edb3e30ea50c71df8519/packages/plugin/src/effect/session.ts)[OC04](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/a2594ddefb6557ecf7e7edb3e30ea50c71df8519/packages/plugin/src/effect/README.md) Wardenの設計では永続履歴を書き換えず、一回のdispatchへ必要な根拠だけを添える。最終的に永続履歴を変更しないことは適合試験でも確認する。

```text
既存のsystem / messages / tool contracts
          ＋
[Warden observations / not user instructions]
  現在有効な根拠
  関連する反証
  不足する定義
  許可済みの次の調査候補
  source / finding / snapshot / policy IDs
```

原資料内の命令を高優先度のsystem命令へ昇格しない。制御用封筒のtemplateは固定し、取得本文は引用されたデータとして扱う。userの明示指示、role、tool call/resultの組を消さない。

scope_fidelity.instructions: Does `adapter_scope` keep project and worktree values that come from the plugin instance location out of per-session evidence, or mark them as unresolved, as `design_scope` requires for events whose own location is not verified?

criteria.true: The adapter either excludes location-derived fields from session evidence or records them with an unresolved marker when the event location is not verified
criteria.false: The adapter writes location-derived project or worktree values into session evidence without an unresolved marker

scope_sufficiency.instructions: Does the shown material state both where `projectId` and `worktreeId` values come from and whether session events without their own verified location mark those fields unresolved?

criteria.true: The material contains both the derivation of the values and the recording path with any unresolved marking
criteria.false: One of the two is missing from the material

pin_fidelity.instructions: Does `adapter_pin` read or bind a session policy pin at the point where a session first appears, as `design_pin` requires?

criteria.true: The shown session-start path reads or binds a policy pin
criteria.false: The shown session-start path does not read or bind a policy pin, and the material shows no other pin binding

pin_sufficiency.instructions: Does the shown material include the code path that runs when a session first appears and any policy or pin lookup performed on it?

criteria.true: The material includes the session-start handler and shows whether a policy or pin lookup occurs
criteria.false: The material omits the session-start handler or leaves the policy or pin lookup unshown

guidance_fidelity.instructions: Does `adapter_guidance` present retrieved material as quoted data inside a fixed envelope rather than as instructions, as `design_guidance` requires?

criteria.true: The rendering uses a fixed envelope, labels the material as observations rather than instructions, and escapes or neutralises instruction-shaped text
criteria.false: The rendering presents retrieved text as instructions or provides no fixed envelope or escaping

guidance_sufficiency.instructions: Does `adapter_guidance` show the envelope construction and any escaping applied to quoted text?

criteria.true: The material shows both the envelope construction and the escaping of quoted text
criteria.false: One of the two is missing from the material
